scope: United States commercial drone package delivery, drone hubs/ports/PADDCs, community impacts, local land-use actions, state law, FAA/NEPA actions, litigation and administrative challenges.

events.title: Florida drone-delivery preemption framework confirmed as current law
events.summary: Florida Statutes §330.41 places broad UAS regulatory authority at the state level and limits local ordinances affecting drone delivery services and drone-port siting, while preserving generally applicable setbacks/landscaping and certain nuisance or illegal-act ordinances.

events.title: North Haven Prime Air center advances into state/federal review
events.summary: A Prime Air Drone Delivery Center proposed at 409 Washington Ave. had received local Planning and Zoning Commission approval; Connecticut environmental review was underway as part of the FAA process.

events.title: Residents raise concerns as Amazon pursues Central Massachusetts expansion
events.summary: Amazon was meeting with local leaders and pursuing regulatory approvals for a proposed Prime Air expansion near Westborough; residents publicly raised concerns about the planned service.

events.title: Amazon announces expansion toward nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns
events.summary: Amazon announced plans to expand Prime Air to nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns by the end of 2026, increasing the number of jurisdictions likely to face siting, public-engagement and land-use questions.

events.title: FAA completes Wing Atlanta environmental review
events.summary: FAA signed a Finding of No Significant Impact/Record of Decision for Wing package-delivery operations in the Atlanta metropolitan area.

events.title: FAA completes Wing Houston environmental review
events.summary: FAA signed a Finding of No Significant Impact/Record of Decision for Wing operations in Houston, where the proposal contemplated up to 75 commercially zoned nest locations.

events.title: Wylie considers special-use zoning for Wing drone delivery
events.summary: The Wylie City Council held a public hearing on a proposed Commercial Corridor Special Use Permit for a Wing drone-delivery service at 707 Cooper Drive.

events.title: FAA signs national drone package-delivery PEA FONSI/ROD
events.summary: FAA completed its national Programmatic Environmental Assessment for drone package delivery and signed a FONSI/ROD. Individual proposals may still require project- or operation-specific environmental review.

events.title: Redmond affirms interim controls on commercial drone-port land uses
events.summary: Redmond adopted Ordinance 3265 affirming its interim official control while permanent commercial drone-port regulations are developed through a public process.

events.title: Auburn Hills documents resident concerns over nearby Prime Air service
events.summary: The City reports resident questions and concerns about noise, privacy, safety and flight frequency associated with Prime Air flights originating nearby, and says it has raised those concerns with Amazon and the FAA.

events.title: FAA completes environmental review for six Florida Prime Air centers
events.summary: FAA signed a FONSI/ROD for six new Prime Air Drone Delivery Centers in Florida, with proposed operations of up to 1,000 MK30 flights per operating day from each PADDC.

events.title: Richardson reports operational changes after drone-noise and flight-path concerns
events.summary: Following resident and city feedback, Amazon reported route adjustments, reduced overflight of a greenway and higher outbound altitudes. The City identifies frequent noise and flight paths as community concerns.

events.title: FAA signs decision covering 22 Texas Prime Air delivery centers
events.summary: FAA signed a FONSI/ROD for Prime Air operations from 22 PADDCs throughout Texas, including major metropolitan areas.
